name: tiles
title: Chrome Web Store marketing tiles
style: v2 — light tile palette declared in assets/tiles.css; independent of promo.css.

captures.note: The marquee reuses the sidebar panel from the English demo capture.

notes: tile-small.png is key art, NOT rendered from HTML — build it with `python3 pipelines/tiles@2/make-small-tile.py`. tile-small.html is kept only as the historical template; rendering it would overwrite the hand-made art.
Alpha is stripped with PIL because the store rejects PNGs with an alpha channel.
